videos.title: Imago Dei (6) - From Womb to Tomb
videos.desc: As image-bearers of God we have value, worth and dignity from even before conception to our final breath.

videos.title: Imago Dei (5) - Every Tribe and Tongue
videos.desc: How does the truth that all of humanity is made in the image of God impact how we treat people from other nations?

videos.title: Imago Dei (4) - A.I. Humanity & The Image of God
videos.desc: Are we in danger of making Technology our God?

videos.title: Imago Dei (3) - Fearfully and Wonderfully Made
videos.desc: Jake explores Psalm 139 to see just how known, made and loved we are.

videos.title: Imago Dei (2) - Male and Female he created them
videos.desc: The Bible teaches us that humanity is made in the image of God (Imago Dei).  Today we focus on God's good design - Male and Female He created them.  In a world that is confused about identity, Martin draws us back to the beginning to rediscover a better picture of humanity where men and women are equal in worth, different in design, united in mission.

videos.title: Imago Dei (1) - Restoring Identity, Reclaiming Dignity, Rediscovering Design
videos.desc: Jake launches our new teaching series exploring what is means to be made in the image of God.

videos.title: The Journey Ends
videos.desc: Matt concludes our Walk with Jesus on the road to Easter  with a look at Luke 24:35-53

videos.title: From Weary To Witness
videos.desc: Two followers of Jesus met him as they walked home on easter Sunday, but they didn't recognise him.  It started with weary souls, but soon their hearts burned as their eyes were opened as they realised who they were with, and everything changed.

videos.title: Jesus burst through death (Easter Sunday 5th April 2026)
videos.desc: Jake helps us see what Jesus has done for all who trust in Him when he rose again

videos.title: Lucas' Story
videos.desc: Lucas was baptised on Easter Sunday .  Listen to his story of transformation.

videos.title: The Price is Right
videos.desc: As part of our "Walk with Jesus" series of talks, Phil helps us understand the cost for Jesus to go to the cross.

videos.title: Who is Jesus? (Sunday 22nd March 2026)
videos.desc:
As we walk with Jesus towards Easter we ask the same question everyone was asking.  Who is Jesus?
Jesus quotes from Psalm 110 to show us who he is.

videos.title: Jesus Restores
videos.desc: As we walk with Jesus to Easter, Clare reminds us, using Peter's experience around 2 fires, of Jesus' heart to  restore all who fail.

videos.title: The Good News According to Micah (Sunday 8th March 2026)
videos.desc: Martin concludes our series looking at Micah with the last 3 verses of the book.  God pardons guilt, overlooks sin, does not stay angry for ever and drown sin.  This is one of the most hope-filled endings to an book.

videos.title: The Mountain of the Lord
videos.desc: Micah is a book full of gloom and doom, but in the middle is a glimmer of hope.  In chapter 4 we read of the mountain that will rise above all others.
